systematic_findings.multi_mapping_problem: All 19 models in the frig-242017801 family are mapped to 6 filters simultaneously. This is a systematic data quality issue — bulk-import or cross-reference expansion without dedup. Each model uses exactly one filter. The 6 mappings include filters from 4 different physical form factors (rear push-in, internal push-button, internal twist-in, ceiling-mounted push-to-lock) — at most one can be correct per model.
systematic_findings.token_consolidation_needed: frig-242017801 and ultrawf are the same physical filter. The repo should consolidate these tokens to prevent double-mapping. Similarly, 242086201 likely corresponds to another known filter and should be identified and consolidated.
systematic_findings.grfs_prefix_correction: The pre-research risk screen described GRFS as side-by-side, but discovery confirms GRFS is French Door (Gallery series). This affects family reconciliation logic.
